r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] knelt, poured the wine on the ground and swore the Oath of the Road: not born on the same day, but to die on the same day.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] cut [INITIATOR_possessive] palm and offered the blade to [RECIPIENT_nameDef]; they swore to be siblings until the end.

li.letterText: {INITIATOR_nameDef} and {RECIPIENT_nameDef} have sworn the Oath of the Road. They were not born of the same blood, but from today they are siblings, and the old oath says they will die on the same day.\n\nSworn siblings rejoice in each other's breakthroughs and grieve each other's deaths like family.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that one day [INITIATOR_pronoun] would leave [RECIPIENT_objective] far behind on the road to heaven.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] measured each other in silence; neither looked away first.

li.letterText: {INITIATOR_nameDef} and {RECIPIENT_nameDef} have become lifelong rivals. Neither will rest while the other is ahead.\n\nRivals cultivate faster when the other is near, and every breakthrough of one is a wound to the other.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] to walk the Dao at [INITIATOR_possessive] side, breath for breath.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] joined their palms and let their qi flow as one.

li.letterText: {INITIATOR_nameDef} and {RECIPIENT_nameDef} have made the Dao vow. From today their cultivation is one: when they cultivate near each other, both advance faster.\n\nThe old texts warn that half a Dao is torn away when a partner dies.

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[RECIPIENT_nameDef] knelt and touched [RECIPIENT_possessive] forehead to the ground three times; [INITIATOR_nameDef] accepted [RECIPIENT_objective] as a disciple.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] watched [RECIPIENT_nameDef] breathe for a long while and said: "Wrong. All wrong. Come back tomorrow at dawn."

li.letterText: {RECIPIENT_nameDef} has knelt three times before {INITIATOR_nameDef} and been accepted as a disciple. From today the master answers for the disciple's cultivation, and the disciple owes the master the respect due to a father.\n\nOther disciples of the same master will be fellow disciples.

li.label: took a disciple
li.description: Someone will carry what I know after I am gone. That is the only immortality the old masters ever trusted.

li.label: accepted as a disciple
li.description: A true master has taken me in. For the first time, the road has someone walking ahead of me.

li.label: sworn the Oath of the Road
li.description: I have a sibling now, chosen and not given. Whatever comes on the road, it comes to both of us.

li.label: found a rival
li.description: Someone thinks they can leave me behind. Let them try. I have not felt this awake in years.

li.label: made the Dao vow
li.description: We will walk the road together, breath for breath. Heaven itself will have to strike us both.
